# Group

[API index](../index)

```typescript
function Group(name?: string | null): GroupScope;
```

Get or create a rule group. Omitting the name addresses the default group.

**Parameter `name`**

Group name. Omit it to use the default group.

**Returns**

The group handle for enabling, disabling, or creating grouped rules.

**Example**

```ts
const group = Group("combat");
group.Disable();
```

**@keywords**

groups, rules, enable, disable
